WOODWORK — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: WOODWORK
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

2. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. International Cricket Team
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. Internal Cooking Timer

3. When learning Trends in woodwork, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Trends in woodwork.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Trends in woodwork.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Trends in woodwork.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Trends in woodwork.

4. When learning Mass Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Mass Production.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Mass Production.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Mass Production.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Mass Production.

5. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. CPU
   C. Speaker
   D. Monitor

6. When learning Project activity, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project activity.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Project activity.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Project activity.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Project activity.

7. When learning Orthographic Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Orthographic Drawing.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Orthographic Drawing.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Orthographic Drawing.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Orthographic Drawing.

8. When learning Portable Power Tools, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Portable Power Tools.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Portable Power Tools.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Portable Power Tools.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Portable Power Tools.

9. When learning Health and Safety in the Workshop, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Health and Safety in the Workshop.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Health and Safety in the Workshop.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Health and Safety in the Workshop.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Health and Safety in the Workshop.

10. When learning Finishing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Finishing.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Finishing.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Finishing.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Finishing.

11. When learning Timber Defects, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Timber Defects.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Timber Defects.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Timber Defects.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Timber Defects.

12. When learning Woodworking Machines, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Woodworking Machines.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Woodworking Machines.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Woodworking Machines.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Woodworking Machines.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Portable Power Tools and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Woodworking Machines and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Timber Defects and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Manufactured boards and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

====

1. D — Wear safety gear and follow instructions

2. C — Information and Communication Technology

3. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Trends in woodwork.

4. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Mass Production.

5. B — CPU

6. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project activity.

7. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Orthographic Drawing.

8. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Portable Power Tools.

9. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Health and Safety in the Workshop.

10. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Finishing.

11. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Timber Defects.

12. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Woodworking Machines.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Portable Power Tools; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
